title: Mashmokh and Water Tanks
statementMd:
Mashmokh is playing a new game. In the beginning he has $*k*$ liters of water and $*p*$ coins. Additionally he has a rooted tree (an undirected connected acyclic graph) that consists of $*m*$ vertices. Each vertex of the tree contains a water tank that is empty in the beginning.

The game begins with the fact that Mashmokh chooses some (no more than $*k*$) of these tanks (except the root) and pours into each of them exactly $1$ liter of water. Then the following process is performed until there is no water remained in tanks.

- The process consists of several steps.
- At the beginning of each step Mashmokh opens doors of all tanks. Then Mashmokh closes doors of some tanks (he is not allowed to close door of tank in the root) for the duration of this move. Let's denote the number of liters in some tank with closed door as $*w*$, Mashmokh pays $*w*$ coins for the closing of that tank during this move.
- Let's denote by $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*m*}$ as the list of vertices of the tree sorted (nondecreasing) by their depth. The vertices from this list should be considered one by one in the order. Firstly vertex $*x*_{1}$ (which is the root itself) is emptied. Then for each vertex $*x*_{*i*}$ $(*i* > 1)$, if its door is closed then skip the vertex else move all the water from the tank of vertex $*x*_{*i*}$ to the tank of its father (even if the tank of the father is closed).

Suppose $*l*$ moves were made until the tree became empty. Let's denote the amount of water inside the tank of the root after the $*i*$-th move by $*w*_{*i*}$ then Mashmokh will win $*max*(*w*_{1}, *w*_{2}, ..., *w*_{*l*})$ dollars. Mashmokh wanted to know what is the maximum amount of dollars he can win by playing the above game. He asked you to find this value for him.

## Input

The first line of the input contains three space-separated integers $*m*, *k*, *p* (2 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}; 0 ≤ *k*, *p* ≤ 10^{9})$.

Each of the following $*m* - 1$ lines contains two space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} (1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *m*; *a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*})$ — the edges of the tree.

Consider that the vertices of the tree are numbered from 1 to $*m*$. The root of the tree has number 1.

## Output

Output a single integer, the number Mashmokh asked you to find.

## Note

The tree in the first sample is shown on the picture below. The black, red, blue colors correspond to vertices with 0, 1, 2 liters of water.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/715ad37bc3e20c52021935adf257821f27688d20.png)

One way to achieve the maximum amount of money is to put 1 liter of water in each of vertices 3 and 4. The beginning state is shown on the picture below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/182d56e467c6cb4d4784d1ac56905da1b9e7179b.png)

Then in the first move Mashmokh will pay one token to close the door of the third vertex tank. The tree after the first move is shown on the picture below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/30f1ae50b02a91829da2059e772625afeb4c13ca.png)

After the second move there are 2 liters of water in the root as shown on the picture below.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1c247872ac7aee0de94e1f35924491c0958f5dcf.png)
statementZhMd:
Mashmokh 正在玩一个新游戏。开始时，他有 $*k*$ 升水和 $*p*$ 枚硬币。此外，他还有一棵有根树（一张无向连通无环图），树中有 $*m*$ 个顶点。每个顶点都包含一个水箱，初始时所有水箱都是空的。

游戏开始时，Mashmokh 选择其中不超过 $*k*$ 个水箱（根节点除外），并向每个选中的水箱中倒入恰好 $1$ 升水。随后，重复进行以下过程，直到所有水箱中都没有水为止。

- 该过程由若干步组成。
- 每一步开始时，Mashmokh 打开所有水箱的门。然后，在这一步的持续时间内，Mashmokh 关闭一些水箱的门（不允许关闭根节点水箱的门）。设某个被关闭门的水箱中有 $*w*$ 升水，则 Mashmokh 需要为这一步关闭该水箱的门支付 $*w*$ 枚硬币。
- 将树中的顶点按照深度非递减的顺序排列，记为 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*m*}$。应按照该顺序依次处理这些顶点。首先清空顶点 $*x*_{1}$（即根节点）。然后，对于每个顶点 $*x*_{*i*}$（$*i* > 1$），如果它的门是关闭的，则跳过该顶点；否则，将其水箱中的所有水移动到其父节点的水箱中（即使父节点水箱的门是关闭的，也要移动）。

设经过 $*l*$ 步后整棵树变为空。记第 $*i*$ 步结束后根节点水箱中的水量为 $*w*_{*i*}$，那么 Mashmokh 将赢得 $*max*(*w*_{1}, *w*_{2}, ..., *w*_{l*})$ 美元。Mashmokh 想知道通过进行上述游戏，他最多能赢得多少美元。请你帮他求出这个值。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 $*m*, *k*, *p* (2 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}; 0 ≤ *k*, *p* ≤ 10^{9})$。

接下来的 $*m* - 1$ 行中，每行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} (1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *m*; *a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*})$，表示树中的一条边。

假设树中的顶点编号为 1 至 $*m*$。树的根节点编号为 1。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即 Mashmokh 要求你求出的数值。

## 说明

第一个样例中的树如下图所示。黑色、红色、蓝色分别表示水量为 0、1、2 升的顶点。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/715ad37bc3e20c52021935adf257821f27688d20.png)

一种达到最大收益的方法是向顶点 3 和 4 中各倒入 1 升水。初始状态如下图所示。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/182d56e467c6cb4d4784d1ac56905da1b9e7179b.png)

在第一步中，Mashmokh 将支付一枚代币，关闭第三个顶点水箱的门。第一步结束后树的状态如下图所示。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/30f1ae50b02a91829da2059e772625afeb4c13ca.png)

第二步结束后，根节点中有 2 升水，如下图所示。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1c247872ac7aee0de94e1f35924491c0958f5dcf.png)
